small_guidance:

Drop BLOCK_HW (e.g. 16/32) and grow BLOCK_OC (64/128) so the GEMM-shaped accumulator stays register-resident; add configs like `(BLOCK_OC=128, BLOCK_HW=16, warps=8)` and `(BLOCK_OC=64, BLOCK_HW=16, warps=4)`.

- Try moving to channels-last input layout so the IC reduction loop loads contiguous bytes; this is the single biggest bandwidth win available without changing strategy.
large_guidance:

- Use channels-last (NHWC) for x and OC-outer weight packing so the K loop loads contiguous IC chunks; fuse subtract+hardswish on the accumulator pre-pool, then max-reduce, then mish, all in registers before the single store.
